note: RIDDLER SEAT 10 — the engineer. Riddle: the explanation IS the story, and the artifact inside the fiction can be real. Stego-native: Cryptonomicon shipped a working cipher (Solitaire, with Schneier) as an appendix. Equivalents ride this shelf (Pynchon, Borges, Danielewski).
interactions: Pynchon: the postal system runs through both — the Tristero's mail and Enoch Root's; V-2 ballistics → Seveneves' orbital rigor (edge within shelf)
Borges: Tlon's fictional encyclopedia is the license for every artifact-in-fiction this shelf ships; 'Shakespeare's Memory' and 'Everything and Nothing' also bind to the shakespeare shelf
Bruce Schneier: co-designed the Solitaire cipher, published as Cryptonomicon's appendix — the only load-bearing cipher shipped inside a novel
Snow Crash (1992) coined 'metaverse'; in 2021 a trillion-dollar company renamed itself Meta after his fiction — the world responded to the artifact
Anathem ← the plato shelf: monastic clockwork around Platonic realism; the concets are Plutarch's symposiums with rakes
walled: The Big U (1984, disowned); Zodiac (1988); Snow Crash (1992); The Diamond Age (1995); Cryptonomicon (1999) + Solitaire appendix
